stem.en: MOND successfully reproduces the observed rotation curves of many individual spiral galaxies using only their visible mass. Why does this success not settle the dark-matter-versus-MOND question in MOND's favor overall?
stem.et: MOND reprodutseerib edukalt paljude üksikute spiraalgalaktikate vaadeldud pöörlemiskõverad, kasutades ainult nende nähtavat massi. Miks ei lahenda see edu tumeaine-versus-MOND küsimust tervikuna MOND-i kasuks?

label.en: MOND significantly underpredicts the mass discrepancy in galaxy clusters and offers no natural account of the Bullet Cluster's mass-light separation, unlike dark matter.
label.et: MOND ennustab oluliselt vähem galaktikaparvede massilahknevust ega paku loomulikku seletust Kuuli parve massi-valguse eraldatusele, erinevalt tumeainest.

label.en: MOND's galactic rotation-curve fits are actually poor and unconvincing, so its apparent success there is illusory to begin with.
label.et: MOND-i galaktiliste pöörlemiskõverate sobitused on tegelikult kehvad ja veenmatud, seega on selle näiline edu seal algusest peale illusoorne.

label.en: It actually does settle the question in MOND's favor -- galaxy clusters and the Bullet Cluster are equally well explained by MOND once the theory's full framework is applied correctly.
label.et: See tegelikult lahendabki küsimuse MOND-i kasuks -- galaktikaparved ja Kuuli parv on MOND-i poolt võrdselt hästi seletatud, kui teooria täielikku raamistikku õigesti rakendada.

label.en: The Bullet Cluster is equally well explained by both theories, so the deciding evidence must come from somewhere else entirely.
label.et: Kuuli parv on seletatud mõlema teooria poolt võrdselt hästi, seega peab otsustav tõendusmaterjal tulema hoopis mujalt.
